data.cultural_impact: Dasrath is a significant name in Hindu mythology, as it was the name of King Rama's father. The epic tale of Rama, known as the Ramayana, is one of the greatest literary works in Indian heritage. The story of Rama and his journey to rescue his wife Sita from the demon king Ravana is a classic tale of love, duty, and righteousness. The name Dasrath is associated with this rich cultural heritage and symbolizes the power and authority of a king who rules justly and maintains peace and order in his kingdom.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dasrath also holds spiritual significance, as it is a reminder of the divine chariots or 'vahanas' that carry the Hindu deities. The ten avatars of Lord Vishnu, who descend on earth to protect the dharma or cosmic order, are symbolized by the ten chariots of Dasrath. The name thus represents the divine presence of Vishnu in Dasrath and the role of a king as a representative of God on earth. The name encourages us to live a righteous and virtuous life, upholding the principles of truth, duty, and selflessness.
